initial_skills.name: loot
initial_skills.source:
# loot(x, y): walk to the kill spot (x, y), find the residue on it or up to 2
# cells away, stand on it and absorb its compute and essence. Returns the
# compute gained, or why it stopped (no residue, a failure reason, too far).
SET gx = x
SET gy = y
SET rid = ""
SET n = 0
SET cx = 0
SET cy = 0
SET sx = -1
SET sy = 1
SET follow = false
SET hx = 0
SET hy = 0
REPEAT 50
  SET dx = gx - here.x
  SET dy = gy - here.y
  SET ax = dx
  IF dx < 0
    SET ax = -dx
  END
  SET ay = dy
  IF dy < 0
    SET ay = -dy
  END
  IF ax + ay == 0
    IF rid != ""
      SET c = absorb(rid, "compute")
      absorb(rid, "essence")
      IF c.ok
        RETURN c.effects.gained
      END
      RETURN c.reason
    END
    IF n > 12
      RETURN "no residue"
    END
    # look at the spot, then at the cells 1 and 2 steps around it
    SET o = observe((gx + cx, gy + cy))
    IF o.ok
      FOR_EACH s IN o.data.entities
        IF s.kind == "residue"
          SET rid = s.id
          SET gx = s.position.x
          SET gy = s.position.y
        END
      END
    END
    SET n = n + 1
    IF n == 1
      SET cx = 1
    ELSE
      SET cx = cx + sx
      SET cy = cy + sy
      IF cx == 0 OR cy == 0
        SET t = sx
        SET sx = -sy
        SET sy = t
      END
      IF cy == 0 AND cx > 0
        SET cx = cx + 1
      END
    END
  ELSE
    # one step toward the goal: the long axis, else the short one, else
    # follow the mountain edge until closer than where it stopped us
    IF follow AND ax + ay < hitd
      SET follow = false
    END
    IF follow
      # too long on this side: turn round and try the other side
      SET fs = fs + 1
      IF fs > lim
        SET hand = -hand
        SET hx = -hx
        SET hy = -hy
        SET fs = 0
        SET lim = lim * 2
      END
      SET ux = -hand * hy
      SET uy = hand * hx
    ELSE
      SET mx = 0
      SET my = 0
      SET ox = 0
      SET oy = 0
      IF ax >= ay
        SET mx = dx / ax
        IF ay > 0
          SET oy = dy / ay
        END
      ELSE
        SET my = dy / ay
        IF ax > 0
          SET ox = dx / ax
        END
      END
      SET ux = mx
      SET uy = my
    END
    SET flip = false
    SET go = true
    REPEAT 5
      IF go
        SET d = "right"
        IF ux < 0
          SET d = "left"
        END
        IF uy > 0
          SET d = "up"
        END
        IF uy < 0
          SET d = "down"
        END
        SET m = move(d)
        IF m.ok
          SET go = false
          SET hx = ux
          SET hy = uy
        ELSE
          IF m.reason != "blocked"
            RETURN m.reason
          END
          IF flip
            SET flip = false
            SET hand = -hand
            SET ux = -ux
            SET uy = -uy
          ELSE
            IF follow
              SET t = ux
              SET ux = hand * uy
              SET uy = -hand * t
            END
          END
          IF NOT follow
            IF ox + oy != 0
              SET ux = ox
              SET uy = oy
              SET ox = 0
              SET oy = 0
            ELSE
              SET follow = true
              SET hitd = ax + ay
              SET fs = 0
              SET lim = 8
              SET hand = 1
              SET flip = true
              SET ux = my
              SET uy = -mx
            END
          END
        END
      END
    END
  END
END
RETURN "too far"

SET hy = 0

initial_skills.name: flee
initial_skills.source:
# flee(threat, n): find the threat anywhere, then take up to n steps straight away from it
# (the long axis first, the other axis when blocked). Returns the distance reached.
SET q = query(threat)
IF NOT q.ok
  RETURN q.reason
END
SET tx = q.data.position.x
SET ty = q.data.position.y
SET dist = 0
REPEAT n
  SET dx = here.x - tx
  SET dy = here.y - ty
  SET ax = dx
  IF dx < 0
    SET ax = -dx
  END
  SET ay = dy
  IF dy < 0
    SET ay = -dy
  END
  SET d1 = "right"
  IF dx < 0
    SET d1 = "left"
  END
  SET d2 = "up"
  IF dy < 0
    SET d2 = "down"
  END
  IF ay > ax
    SET t = d1
    SET d1 = d2
    SET d2 = t
  END
  SET m = move(d1)
  IF NOT m.ok
    SET m = move(d2)
  END
  SET dist = ax + ay + 1
END
RETURN dist
